bio: With its casual yet chic vibe, this lively establishment draws inspiration from the CoBrA art movement. A number of colourful pop art paintings command attention the moment you walk in. Behind the bar, the mixologist is at the ready. All manner of delicious dishes for sharing are served here from noon onwards. For example, you could start off with a lobster roll or pâté en croûte, then have Oedslach beef entrecôte as a main course and round off your meal with tarte Tatin. It's all possible here. No messing around, just simple, delicious flavours that will keep you coming back for more....
